scope: Native coordinated backup-read failure, useful recovery feedback, picker retry and whole-workspace preservation

reproduction.finding: Actual file coordinator propagated presenter URLError -1009; native alert displayed only NSURLErrorDomain error -1009. The guidance assertion failed and the screenshot was inspected.

productionChange: Both independently owned readers present plain-language availability/download/reselection guidance and confirm current work is unchanged. Provider cancellation retains its cancellation code; parsing/size validation stays distinct.
controlledBoundary: Exact isolated DEBUG app IDs plus --backup-provider-failure-testing register a first-read-only NSFilePresenter. Its save callback returns URLError.notConnectedToInternet to the real NSFileCoordinator. The presenter is removed on exit, so choosing the same actual file again performs a normal successful coordinated read. No remote provider or network setting is changed.

ios.coverage: Pending-presenter ordering, failed-presenter rejection and exact file bytes, missing-file retry, prior cancellation, in-flight cancellation and oversized-file rejection

Choose the same file again; verify restore review, then Cancel
